Oaktree Capital Management raised $2 billion for its first dedicated asset-backed finance fund, targeting lending opportunities that fall outside the typical investment constraints of insurers.

Investors include US public pension plans and sovereign wealth funds, according to a statement released Thursday. The fund will provide capital to lenders across a wide range of sectors including equipment leasing, transportation, consumer finance, real estate and infrastructure.
